refuter.evidence: Attacked the nested-program reach of GR4. E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-234/r5nest.cob (run r5nest-001): the container has USE GLOBAL ON SQ-A, and the contained program has USE ON OUTPUT; the contained program's second OPEN OUTPUT SQ-A runs INNER USE ON OUTPUT (41). GR4 could be read to reach across programs, but kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-16-rulings-open-readings.md already ruled it does not: §1985:X.5.5.4 GR1a selects the declarative of the program that holds the statement first. Under that ruling the output is correct.
